description: This Java class 'LoanTermVariationsDataWrapper' manages collections of loan term variation data, including interest rate changes, due date variations, and interest pause variations. It provides methods to check for variations on specific dates, iterate through variations, and categorize variation data.

classes.name: LoanTermVariationsDataWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class that manages different types of loan term variations, categorizing and providing access to interest rate changes, due date variations, and interest pause variations.

methods.name: LoanTermVariationsDataWrapper
methods.description: Constructor initializing variation lists and deriving categorized variations.

methods.name: hasVariation
methods.description: Checks if there is a variation applicable on a given date.

methods.name: hasNext
methods.description: Helper method to determine if a variation exists after a specific date.

methods.name: hasDueDateVariation
methods.description: Checks if there is a due date variation on a given date.

methods.name: nextVariation
methods.description: Returns the next loan term variation.

methods.name: nextDueDateVariation
methods.description: Returns the next due date variation.

methods.name: previousDueDateVariation
methods.description: Returns the previous due date variation.

methods.name: setExceptionData
methods.description: Sets new exception data and re-derives variation categories.

methods.name: adjustNumberOfRepayments
methods.description: Calculates adjustment in number of repayments based on variation types.

methods.name: fetchLoanTermDueDateVariationsData
methods.description: Fetches due date variation data applicable on a specific date.

methods.name: hasExceptionVariation
methods.description: Checks for exception variation on a date using a provided iterator.

methods.name: updateLoanTermVariationsData
methods.description: Adds new variation data and re-categorizes variations.

methods.name: deriveLoanTermVariations
methods.description: Categorizes and sorts variation data into respective lists.

methods.name: resetVariations
methods.description: Resets variation data to unprocessed state and resets iterators.
